script_text: Pattern interrupt: Sagittarius, your Jupiter‑ruled fire is about to clash with Virgo’s Mercury‑governed earth — the sky isn’t asking permission. Elemental chemistry: Fire meets Earth in a tight square between Jupiter in Taurus (your 10th house) and Mercury in Virgo (their 1st), a push‑pull that can ignite growth or burnout. Love language clash: Venus in Sagittarius craves freedom while Mars in Virgo demands precision; the spark is adventure, the friction is relentless nit‑picking. Communication style: Mercury in Virgo opposes your natal Mercury in Sagittarius across the 7th house, so big‑picture talk meets data‑driven replies and misunderstandings flare. Long‑term verdict: Saturn in Pisces sextiles both your 4th and their 10th houses, offering a slow foundation if you both accept structure. Secret tip: Hold a weekly ‘vision‑review’ meeting — without it the square becomes a permanent stalemate. Comment your partner’s sign!
